question: What claim about the source of this teaching must hold if it is said to have been told again by the sky-movers concerning the Mothers?
premises: A teaching concerning the Mothers is in question.
It was told by the sky-movers.
inference: The teaching about the Mothers has been told again by the sky-movers, addressed to the goddess and beloved.
uncertainties: The relation between this teaching and the preceding one is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: Again, O goddess and beloved one, the teaching of the Mothers has been told by the sky-movers.
